description: This file contains unit tests for the prometheus metrics related to the litellm proxy, including tests for request metrics, fallback metrics, team and key budget metrics, and user email tracking.

methods.name: make_bad_chat_completion_request(session, key)
methods.description: Makes a POST request to the chat/completions endpoint with a fake model to simulate failure.

methods.name: make_good_chat_completion_request(session, key)
methods.description: Makes a successful POST request to the chat/completions endpoint.

methods.name: make_chat_completion_request_with_fallback(session, key)
methods.description: Makes multiple POST requests with fallback models to test fallback metrics.

methods.name: test_proxy_failure_metrics()
methods.description: Tests that failure metrics are incremented correctly after a failed request.

methods.name: test_proxy_success_metrics()
methods.description: Tests that success metrics are incremented correctly after a successful request.

methods.name: verify_latency_metrics(metrics: str)
methods.description: Verifies that latency buckets in metrics match expected PROMETHEUS LATENCY_BUCKETS.

methods.name: test_proxy_fallback_metrics()
methods.description: Checks fallback metrics after a request with fallback models.

methods.name: str create_test_team( session: aiohttp.ClientSession, team_data: Dict[str, Any] )
methods.description: Creates a new test team via API and returns its team_id.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_test_user( session: aiohttp.ClientSession, user_data: Dict[str, Any] )
methods.description: Creates a new test user via API and returns user info.

methods.name: str get_prometheus_metrics(session: aiohttp.ClientSession)
methods.description: Fetches the current metrics from the /metrics endpoint.

methods.name: Dict[str,float] extract_budget_metrics(metrics_text: str, team_id: str)
methods.description: Extracts budget-related metrics for a team from Prometheus metrics text.

methods.name: str create_test_key(session: aiohttp.ClientSession, team_id: str)
methods.description: Generates a new test API key for a team.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_team_info(session: aiohttp.ClientSession, team_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches info about a specific team.

methods.name: test_team_budget_metrics()
methods.description: Tests the team budget tracking metrics over simulated requests.

methods.name: str create_test_key_with_budget( session: aiohttp.ClientSession, budget_data: Dict[str, Any] )
methods.description: Creates a test API key with specified budget constraints.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_key_info(session: aiohttp.ClientSession, key: str)
methods.description: Fetches info about a specific API key.

methods.name: Dict[str,float] extract_key_budget_metrics(metrics_text: str, key_id: str)
methods.description: Extracts budget metrics for a specific API key from metrics text.

methods.name: test_key_budget_metrics()
methods.description: Tests the API key budget tracking metrics over requests.

methods.name: test_user_email_metrics()
methods.description: Checks that user email labels are tracked correctly in metrics after creating a user.

methods.name: test_user_email_in_all_required_metrics()
methods.description: Verifies that user email labels are present across various metrics.

ctags.name: create_test_key
ctags.pattern: /^async def create_test_key(session: aiohttp.ClientSession, team_id: str) -> str:$/

ctags.name: extract_budget_metrics
ctags.pattern: /^def extract_budget_metrics(metrics_text: str, team_id: str) -> Dict[str, float]:$/

ctags.name: extract_key_budget_metrics
ctags.pattern: /^def extract_key_budget_metrics(metrics_text: str, key_id: str) -> Dict[str, float]:$/

ctags.name: get_key_info
ctags.pattern: /^async def get_key_info(session: aiohttp.ClientSession, key: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/

ctags.name: get_team_info
ctags.pattern: /^async def get_team_info(session: aiohttp.ClientSession, team_id: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/
